{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hotel Drofo''' was an exclusive [[Hotel/Legends|lodging]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] establishment, located on the [[Esplanade]] on [[Oseon 6845]]. The expensively decorated surface entrance of the resort was painted in gold and purple livery. Just inside, eight [[Turbolift/Legends|down-shafts]] led to the hotel proper. The ''Grand Lobby'' of the hotel was located on the lowest level, along with the many small, comfortably furnished gaming salons.
